Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ১) Choose the correct sentence.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option1: ক) We drive to the grocery store this afternoon.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option2: খ) We drove to the grocery store this afternoon.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option3: গ) We drives to the grocery store this afternoon.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option4: ঘ) We driven to the grocery store this afternoon.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: বাক্যটিতে This afternoon থাকায় তা past indefinite tense হবে। তাই ‘We drove to the grocery store this afternoon.’ ই সঠিক বাক্য।

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ২) Which is not a grammatical unit?
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp:
Grammatical part: Clause, Morpheme, Phrase etc.
Writing part: Paragraph, Report, Essay etc.

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৩) The antonym of ‘fatal’ is:
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp:
Fatal /adj/ মারাত্বক,প্রাণনাশক।
Constructive /adj/ গঠনমূলক।

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৪) Did you expect ________ ?
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option1: ক) that he will visit you
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option4: ঘ) that he would visit you
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: Expect somebody to do something অর্থ কাউকে কোন কিছু করবে বলে প্রত্যাশা করা। তাই শূন্যস্থানের জন্য সঠিক sequence হলো him to visit you.

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৫) What is the synonym of ‘look’?
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp:
Gaze: বদ্ধদৃষ্টিতে তাকিয়ে থাকা।
Glean: ক্ষেতে পড়ে থাকা শস্যকণা কুড়ান; সংগ্রহ করা।
Gloss: মসৃণতা, চাকচিক্য।
Glimpse: ক্ষণিকের জন্য দেখিতে পাত্তয়া

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৬) The  antonym of the word ‘liberty’ is-
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: Bondage- the state of being another person's slave.

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৭) Choose the correct sentence.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option1: ক) Between you and I, I doubt that he will come.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option2: খ) Between you and I, I doubt that he would come.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option3: গ) Between you and me, I doubt that he will come.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option4: ঘ) Between you and me, I doubt that he would come.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: Between এর পরে pronoun এর objective form বসে এবং doubt present tense এ থাকায় that এর পর future tense হবে।

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৮) A Paragraph must have___theme/themes.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: Paragraph একটি theme এর উপর লেখা হয়। তবে paragraph এর সাধারনত ৩টি অংশ থাকে। Topic sentence, Body and Concluding remarks.

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৯) Choose the correct sentence.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option1: ক) It had been raining all day today.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option2: খ) It was raining all day today.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option3: গ) It rains all day today.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option4: ঘ) It has been raining all day today.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: বাক্যে all day today থাকায় বাক্যটি present perfect continuous tense হবে।

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ১০) The  synonym of ‘sanguine’ is ____ .
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: Sanguine- নিশ্চিত, আশাবাদী; Optimistic- আশাবাদী।

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ১১) Choose the correct sentence.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option1: ক) I have a bone to pick on you.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option2: খ) I have a bone to pick for you.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option3: গ) I have a bone to pick with you.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option4: ঘ) I have a bone to pick at you.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: ‘To have a bone to pick with somebody’ হলো একটি phrase. যার অর্থ তর্ক বা নালিশ করার মতো কোন ব্যাপার থাকা।

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ১২) The judge decided to <u>exonerate</u> the accused. The bold faced word means ____ .
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp:
Exonerate /verb/ পুনর্বাসন করা।
acquit- বেকসুর খালাস দেওয়া।

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ১৩) Choose the correct sentence-
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option1: ক) Let he and you be witnesses
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option2: খ) Let you and he be witnesses
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option3: গ) Let you and him be witnesses
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option4: ঘ) Let you and he be witness
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: Let শব্দটির পর pronoun এর objective form বসে। এইধরনের sentence এ প্রথমে 2nd, 3rd সবশেষে 1st person বসে।

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ১৪) Which one is not the meaning of ‘Tender’?
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp:
Live পরীক্ষায় ভুলে "Not" শব্দটি লেখা ছিল না।
Tender-এর অনেক গুলো অর্থ রয়েছে। Adjective হিসেবে tender age নির্দেশ করলে অর্থ হবে young। এর আরেকটি অর্থ compassionate(স্নেহপরায়ণ )। Noun হিসাবে tender অর্থ দরপত্র অর্থাৎ a rate chart। কিন্ত right on properties (সম্পত্তির অদিকার) tender শব্দটির অর্থ নয়।

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question:
১৫) Find a synonym of the bold faced word:
I’d like to initiate my argument with an anecdote whose significance will soon become apparent.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: Initiate something with something প্রদত্ত ব্যাক্যে থাকায় preface শব্দটি বসবে কেননা preface something with something বসে।  preface something with something অর্থ কোনো কিছুর মুখবন্ধ সংযোজন করা।

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ১৬) The antonym of REBUFF-
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: Rebuff (verb): reject (someone or something) in an abrupt or ungracious manner.

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ১৭) Cohesion and coherence is essential in____
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp:
Cohesion (Unity) & Coherence (Logical Sequence of thoughts) is essential in paragraph writing.
Source: High School English Grammar and Composition by Wren and Martin.

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ১৮) The antonym of QUELL-
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: Quell- বিদ্রোহ দমন করা; Foment- বিদ্রোহে প্ররোচিত করা।

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ১৯) The antonym of IMPRECISION-
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: Imprecision: lack of exactness or accuracy.

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ২০) What is the meaning of the word ‘post-mortem’?
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp:
Post-mortem(noun): an examination of a dead body to determine the cause of death.
Autopsy(noun): a post-mortem examination to discover the cause of death or the extent of disease.

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ২১) A report is usually written in _______ .
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: No explanation added.

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ২২) The expression ‘voir dire’ means-
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp:
"Voir Dire" অর্থ "telling the truth"।

এটি একটি আইনগত পরিভাষা যা সাধারণত আদালতে ব্যবহৃত হয়। এটি প্রধানত দুটি ক্ষেত্রে ব্যবহৃত হয়:

1. জুরি নির্বাচন: সম্ভাব্য জুরিদের প্রশ্ন করে দেখা হয় তারা পক্ষপাতদুষ্ট কিনা।

2. প্রমাণের গ্রহণযোগ্যতা নির্ধারণ: বিচারক সিদ্ধান্ত নেন কোনো নির্দিষ্ট সাক্ষ্য বা প্রমাণ আদালতে গ্রহণযোগ্য কিনা।

এটি "সাক্ষীর প্রমাণ" (evidence of the witness) বোঝায় না, কারণ Voir Dire হল একটি প্রাথমিক পরীক্ষা, যেখানে বিচারক বা আইনজীবীরা সাক্ষী বা জুরিদের যাচাই করেন, কিন্তু এটি সাক্ষ্যের মূল উপস্থাপনা নয়।

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ২৩) The correct sentence of the followings-
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option1: ক) A new cabinet has been sworn in Dhaka
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option2: খ) A new cabinet has been sworn in in Dhaka
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option3: গ) A new cabinet has been sworn by in Dhaka
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option4: ঘ) A new cabinet has sworn in Dhaka
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: Swear in শপথ গ্রহণ করা এবং স্থানের নামের পূর্বে in হবে। আবার শপথ কাজটি প্রধান বিচারপ্রতি করান, cabinet নিজে করে না। তাই বাক্যটি passive voice হবে।

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ২৪) The abbreviation ‘a.m.’ stands for____
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: From the Latin words meridies (midday), ante (before) and post (after), the term ante meridiem (a.m.) means before midday and post meridiem (p.m.) means after midday.

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ২৫) ‘Excuse me’ gentlemen! Here, ‘Excuse me’ is used to ______ .
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: মনোযোগ আকর্ষণ করার জন্যই প্রদত্ত বাক্যটিতে ‘Excuse me’ ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question:
২৬) The sentence that makes correct use of the structure:
It +be +Adjective +of +N /P +Infinitive is-
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option1: ক) It is kind of him to support us.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option2: খ) It is unwise of your going there.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option3: গ) It is unusual of him to making such mistakes.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option4: ঘ) It is nice of them that they waited for you.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: No explanation added.

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ২৭) Rain sounds is called-
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp:
Jingle- ঝন ঝন ধ্বনি বা ধাতব পদার্থের শব্দ।
Ticks- ঘড়ির টিক টিক শব্দ।
Rustle- মর্মর ধ্বনি বা শুকনো পাতার শব্দ।
Patters- চড়চড় ধ্বনি বা বৃষ্টি পড়ার শব্দ।

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ২৮) It is, you know, <u>me who is</u> the person responsible for scheduling meetings in the conference room.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: Be verb এর পর pronoun এর subjective form বসে। Me এর subjective form হলো I . তাই ‘me who is’ এর পরিবর্তে ‘I who am’ হবে যা অপশনে নেই। তাই সঠিক উত্তর ‘None’.

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ২৯) Choose the correct spelling from the given options.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: Precinct- the area within the walls of a particular building or place.

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৩০) Culture influences the way __________ .
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option2: খ) that we view the world
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option4: ঘ) is the view of the world
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: সঠিক sequence টি হলো the way that + sub + verb + extension.

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৩১) The correctly spelt word is-
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: Schizophrenic- ভগ্নমনস্কতা বিষয়ক।

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৩২) Which one is correct?
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option1: ক) He went out of doors.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option2: খ) He went out of door.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: অপশন ‘খ’ এর বাক্যটি সঠিক হতো যদি door এর পূর্বে ‘the’ article থাকতো।

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৩৩) Find out the correctly spelt word-
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: Re-con-nais-sance: যে কোন ধরনের কাজ শুরু করার পূর্বে প্রাথমিক জরিপ।

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৩৪) Which one of the following is a correct sentence?
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option1: ক) He insisted her to go there.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option2: খ) He did not insist her to go there.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option3: গ) He insist her going there.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option4: ঘ) He insisted on her going there.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: Insist এর পর preposition ‘on’ হবে।

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৩৫) Which of the following is not an incorrect spelling?
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: Con-scio-nable: বিবেকবান, বিবেক বুদ্ধি সম্পন্ন।

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৩৬) Which is the correct sentence?
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option1: ক) Let he and I go.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option2: খ) Let I and he go.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option3: গ) Let me and he go.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option4: ঘ) Let him and me go.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: Imperative sentence এ let এর পর pronoun এর objective form বসে।

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৩৭) Choose the correctly spelt word____
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: Accommodate: to provide a place to live or to be stored in, to give what is needed to someone.

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৩৮) The incorrect sentence is
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option1: ক) She doesn't attend class regularly
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option2: খ) They don't attend class regularly
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option3: গ) She don't attend class regularly
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option4: ঘ) She does attend class regularly
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: অপশন ‘গ’ এর বাক্যটি গঠনগত ভাবে ভুল। বাক্যটির সঠিক গঠন হবে- She doesn't attend class regularly.

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৩৯) The adjective of the word ‘instant’ is____
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: Instantaneous (adjective): occurring or done instantly.

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৪০) Which of the following is correct?
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option1: ক) I thought he loves me
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option2: খ) I thought he loved me
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option3: গ) I thought he will love me
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option4: ঘ) I thought he may love me
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: main clause এ past tense আছে তাই subordinate clause ও past tense হবে।

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৪১) What is the adjective of ‘Literature’?
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: Literary (adjective): concerning the writing, study, or content of literature, especially of the kind valued for quality of form.

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৪২) Which of the following sentence is correct?
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option1: ক) Give me a few butter, please
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option2: খ) Give me a little butters please.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option3: গ) I have a little money
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: ‘Money’ uncountable noun হওয়ায় এর পূর্বে a little বসে।

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৪৩) Which one is the verb of ‘family’?
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: No explanation added.

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৪৪) Which one is the correct sentence?
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option1: ক) Much of it is true.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option2: খ) Much of it are true.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option3: গ) Many of it is true.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option4: ঘ) A few of it are true.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: It এর পূর্বে much of বসে এবং much of it এর পর singular verb বসে।

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৪৫) Which is not an acceptable adjective form of the verb ‘vary’?
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: Variable, various এবং varied সবগুলো শব্দই প্রচলিত শব্দ যাদেরকে vary এর adjective শব্দ হিসেবে ধরা যায়। কিন্তু variful শব্দটি অপ্রচলিত, অনেক ভালো ভালো ডিকশনারীতেও শব্দটিকে পাওয়া যায় নি; তাই এটিকে vary এর adjective শব্দ হিসেবে গ্রহণ করা যায় না।

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৪৬) Choose the correct sentence
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option1: ক) Give me little butter please.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option2: খ) Give me few butter please.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option3: গ) Give me a little butter please.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option4: ঘ) Give me a few butter please.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: Uncountable noun এর ক্ষেত্রে little/a little এবং countable noun এর ক্ষেত্রে few/a few ব্যবহৃত হয়।

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৪৭) The noun form of ‘Recognise’ is-
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: Recognition(n): identification of someone or something or person from previous encounters or knowledge.

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৪৮) Choose the correct one form below:
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option1: ক) She frowns upon my attire.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option2: খ) She frowns at my attire.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option3: গ) She frowns on my attire.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option4: ঘ) She frowns with my attire.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: Frown at something অর্থ কোন কিছু দেখে ভ্রূকুটি করা।

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৪৯) How many parts are there in a letter?
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: There are six parts in a letter. These are - 1. Heading of the letter, 2. Salutation or Greetings, 3. The body of the letter, 4. The subscription, 5. The signature of the writer and 6. The superscription of address.

Corrections, Words and Compositions.question: ৫০) Choose the correct sentence.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option1: ক) Things are to be rejecting if quality is compromised.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option2: খ) Things are to be rejected if quality is compromised.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option3: গ) Things are to being rejected if quality is compromised.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.option4: ঘ) Things have rejected if quality is compromised.
Corrections, Words and Compositions.exp: Passive করতে গেলে সাধারণত সম্ভাব্য সকল clause কে passive করতে হয়।
